question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"said to."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Said to"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank, as it fits grammatically and makes sense in the context of the sentence.
 
• **"Said to"** means to speak or tell somebody something, using words. ((शब्‍दों की सहायता से) (किसी को कुछ) कहना; बोलना)
 
 
• **Example**: *He **said to**__ lead a happy life.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct passage:

The figure of Arthur first appeared in Welsh poetry in the __late__ sixth and early seventh centuries, a hero who was __said to__ lead the Britons in battle against Saxon invaders. But it wasn’t ______ (3) ______ the 12th century that he was first tied to this dramatic headland, known as Tintagel.

The timeless popularity of the Arthur legend has overshadowed a central, unresolved ______ (4) ______: Was there really a King Arthur, or at least a historical prototype upon whom Geoffrey's hero is ______ (5) ______? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Asked to"** and **"brought to" **do not make sense in the context of the sentence, as they do not convey the idea of communication or conveying a message.
 
• **"Told" **could work in the sentence, but **"said to"** is a more natural and commonly used phrase in English.
